limits: Huawei signatures and per-record checksums not verified; ZIP CRC and archive digests are separate checks.
No phone installation, rollback acceptance or restoration tested.
Android-9 base VERSION.mbn says 9.1.0.399 while its BASE_VER is Marie-LGRP2-OVS 9.1.0.279; preserve both labels.
Android-9 BASE_VERLIST does not name MAR-LGRP2-OVS 10.0.0.1. The complete validation logic and meaning of this omission remain unverified.

Android-9 base has separate SYSTEM/VENDOR/ODM/PRODUCT records; Android-10 base instead includes SUPER and additional vbmeta records. Partition-layout migration must be checked before choosing any write procedure.
Firmware binaries, original screenshots, private paths and complete PC diagnostics stay outside the project repository.
